narr: Low pressure, Post-Tropical Cyclone Chantal, induced heavy rain and flash flooding across portions of the region.
ev: Flash flooding occurred along Reedville Road,. The road was impassable.

Flash flooding was reported on Township Road and Conner Road.
Flash flooding occurred on the West Branch of Big Elk Creek. Water rose out of its banks onto Old Creek Road and Oxford Roads.
A vehicle became stuck in flood waters near US 1 and Limestone Road.
Significant flash flooding was reported across multiple roads.
